to resound, reverberate, roar, thunder, RV. &c. &c.;
to utter inarticulate sounds, Vās. :

Intens. तंस्तन्यते, तंस्तन्ति, ib. (2. sg. Impv. तंस्तनीहि See अभि-ष्टन्).
